To this end, we have spent a lot of time collecting topographical information for the entire planet, and presenting it in an intuitive and practical way.  If there is a small hill or valley in the area you are interested in looking at, it will likely be obvious in Mapster. Approximately a billion points make up the current OpenStreetMap data set, and the collection is continuing to grow at an astounding rate.
    
Mapster doesn't rely on mapping data that quickly becomes outdated. As a Mapster user, you obtain privileged access to incredible maps of our entire planet, at a level of detail never before seen.

If you are planning on exploring an area, all you need to do is tell Mapster to download the details of that location before you leave.
